description.en: A personal monthly budget, 100% local and offline: several PIN-protected accounts, a calendar of charges and purchases, loans, a calculator, full personalization and an automatic backup before uninstalling. With Nebula News, a “Learn” card shows today’s finance articles, without ever sending anything from your budget. Explicitly not a banking app: no bank, no market data, no online account.
